description: Section 8.3 locale-identity clause: filenames spelled zh-hant, nb-no, und, private use, and the three alias-bearing tags hy-SU/ru-SU/pap-AN loaded together, so the emitted locale list shows exactly which normalization the loader applies to a filename. Load-only, and necessarily so: no `en` file is present, so the `en` fallback locale has no canonically equivalent loaded locale and DefaultStrings could not be constructed even if a case wanted one.
